name: Paranoidal-Droid-M-O
title: Paranoidal Droid M-O
author: Klaudia (Sweepbot), Paranoidal
description: Д-ОК (M-O), the Microbe Obliterator of the BnL starliners, on your paved floors: from his charging station he hunts every foreign contaminant on the paving — grass and grit, muddy prints the engineer brings in, items on the floor, remains, small wreck debris, which he breaks down for a few parts — and scrubs dirty engineers themselves. Built on Klaudia's Sweepbot.
